events.title: PSEG CEO: Nuclear outlook for New Jersey improves on lifting of moratorium
events.body: Nuclear power plants won’t be built, however, without long-term federal financial support and hyperscaler offtake agreements, said Ralph LaRossa, Public Service Enterprise Group CEO.
